Julia Broome's strategy content dominates this lane and pulls all available attention; latecomers get negligible returns.

hooks.rationale: Models the contrarian hot-take pattern that drove 2.16x and 2.51x multipliers for @juliabroome this cycle. It creates tension by implying a gap between client expectation and the craft behind it, which pulls hospitality decision-makers into the caption. Natalie's Forbes Five-Star training gives her the credibility to own this claim without it reading as arrogant.

Directly models the scene-setting POV format behind @rocioprezg's 2.90x hotel-opening reel, the single highest engagement multiplier in this cycle from a hospitality photographer. Sensory and time-specific, it sells access and presence without naming a property, making it reusable across shoots. Fits Natalie's natural-light pillar precisely.

Adapts the named-place curiosity-gap formula from @jameslloydcole's 2.39x Gresgarth Hall post, which consistently beat his scenic location content. Layering a specific geography with a restricted time window creates aspiration and access signal. Natalie's London residency plan makes UK hospitality content a natural on-brand extension of her Boston practice.

citations.text: Instagram Post Scraper — Apify. Public post data for all watchlist accounts.
Instagram Reel Scraper — Apify. Transcript and audio metadata for spoken-audio reels.
Document Text Detection — Google Cloud Vision API.
Engagement baseline methodology: each creator's median engagement over their last 25 posts. Multiplier = post engagement ÷ creator median.
Analysis: Claude (Anthropic). Hook classification, theme clustering, open lane identification, and hook generation in Natalie's voice.
